name: Spatial scene transitions
looks: Every scene change uses a spatial move rather than a crossfade: a circle or soft circle wipe growing from a point, a diagonal pixel staircase filling the frame, a line thickening into a flooding band, vertical shutters rising, the through-line dot growing into the next ground, a motion-blurred whip sideways, or a camera push diving into an object. Each one lands squarely on a beat.
build: Drive each wipe from a clip-path or mask variable tweened on an easing curve matched to the move (power2-in for a hard wipe, power3-in for a flood), or from a canvas drawing staggered blocks with seeded jitter for the staircase; grow the blur and skew together for a whip, and the field-of-view and canvas blur together for a push.
sound: A whoosh into each wipe, a glitch on the pixel wipe, and a hit on the flood.
prompt: Change scenes with a spatial move rather than a crossfade: a wipe growing from a point, a staircase of blocks filling diagonally, a line thickening into a flood, rising shutters, a mark growing into the next scene's ground, or a motion-blurred whip or push, each landing exactly on a beat. Reserve a true hard cut only for a rapid one-word-per-beat sequence.
source: the 2026 Opus showreels; built in examples/reel-2026-10-06.html.
